claims.publish_rule: No actual referred checkout established.

claims.publish_rule: Actual referred order terms/exclusions unknown; do not guarantee outcomes.

claims.statement: A 12-minute Zen12 session equals an hour of meditation
claims.publish_rule: Suppress claimed equivalence.

claims.statement: Zen12 audio automatically reproduces meditative brainwaves
claims.publish_rule: No independent product-specific substantiation.

claims.statement: Zen12 treats anxiety or other mental-health conditions
claims.publish_rule: Do not use.

claims.statement: Intensive meditation training changed attentional-blink/EEG measures in research
claims.publish_rule: Three months intensive training, not retail audio.

claims.statement: Attentional blink original timing effect
claims.publish_rule: 1992 probe deficit under stated task/timing.

claims.statement: Two-target RSVP deficit and two-stage model
claims.publish_rule: 200–500ms typical task window; model interpretation.

claims.statement: Object vs temporal-interval task matters
claims.publish_rule: Task selection changes effect.

claims.statement: Individual differences in attentional blink
claims.publish_rule: Not universal, not individual medical diagnostic.

claims.statement: Target continuity changes attentional blink
claims.publish_rule: Challenges simplistic fixed-capacity picture.

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus is a seller-described 33-minute/47MB audio
claims.publish_rule: Duration and download size only, not outcome proof.

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus creates on-demand razor-sharp concentration
claims.publish_rule: Suppress guaranteed concentration/career benefit.

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus refund offer context
claims.publish_rule: Public 14-day statement; exact referred bundle/FAQ exceptions not authenticated.

claims.statement: Brainwave Shots Focus Shot includes 15-minute/30-minute versions
claims.publish_rule: Seller-described formats.

claims.statement: Brainwave Shots Focus Shot gives hours of enhanced focus
claims.publish_rule: Suppress outcome duration.

claims.statement: Brainwave Shots Focus Shot offers one-year guarantee
claims.publish_rule: Confirm referred order terms before quoting as buyer guarantee.

claims.statement: Public affiliate portal advertises network and payments
claims.publish_rule: Portal's marketing about payouts is not FV commission contract.

claims.statement: FV named acceptance, authorized WEBSITE/EMAIL/SOCIAL, issued earning link
claims.publish_rule: Targeted Gmail search 17 Nov returned consumer promotions and generic pending enrollment; no FV acceptance.

claims.statement: FTC paid recommendation must disclose material connection clearly near recommendation
claims.publish_rule: Place disclosure in same visual context as earning link.

claims.statement: Health-product objective claims need competent reliable scientific substantiation
claims.publish_rule: An unrelated meditation experiment is insufficient.

claims.statement: FV Puységur archive documents source trail and ethical failures
claims.publish_rule: Not proof animal magnetism or modern audio.

claims.statement: Existing Fieldbook is free 52-page single-Dispatch resource
claims.publish_rule: No payable SKU, no added list, no actual lead confirmation.

claims.statement: FV historical index reports 61 investigations
claims.publish_rule: Context only, not traffic/customer validation.

claims.statement: Two live site bridges: change blindness and Mesmerism
claims.publish_rule: Grounded URLs; no invented Mind draft live route.

claims.statement: FV has actual sellable rights-cleared Mind product SKU
claims.publish_rule: Fieldbook is free; no paid offer established.

claims.statement: Verified FV affiliate sales, settled commissions, refunds and net revenue
claims.publish_rule: No transaction/denominator; do not report numeric zero as a measured result.

claims.publish_rule: Do not reproduce any merchant ad or claim affiliate creative is approved.
